vsinger_inherit_from_parents_effect = {
	# --- First, calculate the weight for each lineage ---
	set_variable = { name = luotianyi_weight value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:mother ?= { has_luotianyi_lineage_trait = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = luotianyi_weight add = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:real_father ?= { has_luotianyi_lineage_trait = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = luotianyi_weight add = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = yuezhengling_weight value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:mother ?= { has_yuezhengling_lineage_trait = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = yuezhengling_weight add = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:real_father ?= { has_yuezhengling_lineage_trait = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = yuezhengling_weight add = 100 }
	}

	# --- Then, randomly select a lineage ---
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			weight = var:luotianyi_weight
			vsinger_inherit_luotianyi_lineage_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			weight = var:yuezhengling_weight
			vsinger_inherit_yuezhengling_lineage_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

	random_list = {

# This effect creates a random human appearance for sons of two Vsinger parents.
vsinger_fallback_to_random_human_effect = {
	create_character = {
		gender = male
		age = 0
		culture = root.culture
		faith = root.faith
		father = global_var:anime_dummy_male
		mother = global_var:anime_dummy_female
		save_scope_as = dummy_child
	}
	scope:dummy_child = {
		copy_inheritable_appearance_to = root
		death = natural
	}
	set_muggle_ethnicity = yes
}
